about: Questions with known answers about this repository, for `cairnmind eval repository .` (see docs/EVALUATION.md). A value that can change (a version, a default, a limit) is read from the named file at run time by the pattern; a fixed answer is listed. This file is left out of the copy that is indexed, so it cannot be quoted.

questions.question: Which Python version does this project require?

answer.pattern: and ([0-9]+) when a required model or client is unavailable
